column1: # Chat FALSE-POSITIVE traps (QA-owned): innocent text that contains a bad substring, or that becomes one when spaces are
# removed, or that is bad in another of our 10 languages. The chat filter is language-agnostic (players of every locale
# share rooms), so every row must survive unchanged for everybody.
# expect: CLEAN = cleaned text equals the input exactly. EITHER = undecided; invariants only.
# Same columns and escapes as chat_profanity.tsv. term = the trap substring (informational).
# Format: UTF-8, tab-separated, '#' starts a comment line, first non-comment line is the header.
# Escapes in text columns (decoded by the QA loaders, QaCorpus.kt):
#   \R[N:TEXT] repeats TEXT N times (inside TEXT write \] for ']').
# Invisible, control, bidi and confusable characters are ALWAYS written as escapes so a reviewer can see them;
# QaCorporaWellFormedTest fails if a raw invisible/control/bidi character appears in this file.
